commit.message:
feat: generate controlled page-level MS screenshot asset package (#1490)

Render real page-level MS screenshots for all 424 unique page/exact-located
pages from the merged #1489 locator backfill, deduped by ms_document_id +
source_pdf_sha256 + pdf_page_index_zero_based.

Rendering is deterministic local PDF rasterization (pdfjs-dist + @napi-rs/canvas
at scale 2.0, bundled standard fonts and cmaps): repeated runs produce
byte-identical PNGs and an identical package content hash. No OCR/VLM/external
model call, no Supabase/RAG/vector mutation.

Binaries land only in the gitignored controlled package root
data/ms-screenshots/post-attempt-ms-page-screenshots/v1-9709 (80MB, 424 PNGs),
never in git and never under a frontend public/static directory. Each asset
carries an output_image_sha256, byte size, rendered dimensions, a controlled
reveal-authorized reference, and a per-asset generation command that actually
re-renders that page from its source hash and page locator.

Hard requirements held: student_display_allowed_count=0,
public_static_url_allowed_count=0, pre_attempt_fetch_allowed_count=0,
preload_in_frontend_bundle_allowed_count=0, git_committed_binary_count=0.
Screenshots stay candidate_internal; no visual QA pass is claimed (that is #1491).

The validator checks the git index directly for this package's screenshot
binaries and fails on any committed binary without explicit authorization.
No P0 blocker: all 170 source PDFs are present with matching hashes, so the
blocker map is emitted empty.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
